title: lichen-core integration test ccp16_desync_vectors.rs does not compile: missing use serde_json::Value
description: cargo test -p lichen-core fails to compile the ccp16_desync_vectors integration test at HEAD (pre-existing since merge f94dd6289f; unrelated to 5m15). Error E0425 x2 at tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs:12,17 — functions vectors() and find_case() use bare type Value but the file only imports lichen_core::desync::{DesyncFSM, DesyncState}; serde_json is used fully-qualified in from_str so only the type import is missing. Fix: add 'use serde_json::Value;' after line 10. This blocks the entire crate test target (any worker running cargo test -p lichen-core hits the compile failure before any test runs). lib tests unaffected: 412 pass. Discovered while verifying 5m15 clamp fix.
